arxiv-2001-07365.title: Simultaneous Input and State Set-Valued ℋ ∞ \mathcal{H}_{\infty} -Observers For Linear Parameter-Varying Systems Thanks: M. Khajenejad and S.Z. Yong are with the School for Engineering of Matter, Transport and Energy, Arizona State University, Tempe, AZ, USA (e-mail: mkhajene@asu.edu, szyong@asu.edu
arxiv-2001-07365.creator: Mohammad Khajenejad, Sze Zheng Yong
arxiv-2001-07365.description: Abstract A fixed-order set-valued observer is presented for linear parameter-varying systems with bounded-norm noise and under completely unknown attack signals, which simultaneously finds bounded sets of states and unknown inputs that include the true state and inputs. The proposed observer can be designed using semidefinite programming with LMI constraints and is optimal in the minimum ℋ ∞ \mathcal{H}_{\infty} -norm sense.

arxiv-2212-09880.title: Experimental Low-speed Positioning System with VecTwin Rudder for Automatic Docking (Berthing)
arxiv-2212-09880.creator: Dimas M. Rachman, Yusuke Aoki, Yoshiki Miyauchi, Naoya Umeda, Atsuo Maki
arxiv-2212-09880.description: Abstract A VecTwin rudder system comprises twin fishtail rudders with reaction fins to increase its performance. With a constant propeller revolution number, the vessel can execute special low-speed maneuvers like hover, crabbing, reverse, and rotation. Such low-speed maneuvers are termed dynamic positioning (DP), and a DP vessel should be fully/overly actuated with several thrusters.

arxiv-2307-02752.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Imbalanced Datasets
arxiv-2307-02752.creator: Li Jiang, Sijie Cheng, Jielin Qiu, Haoran Xu, WaiKin Chan, Ding Zhao, Li Jiang, Sijie Cheng, Jielin Qiu, Haoran Xu, WaiKin Chan, Ding Zhao
arxiv-2307-02752.description: Abstract The prevalent use of benchmarks in current offline reinforcement learning (RL) research has led to a neglect of the imbalance of real-world dataset distributions in the development of models. The real-world offline RL dataset is often imbalanced over the state space due to the challenge of exploration or safety considerations.

arxiv-2404-11396.title: Convergece rate and uniform Lipschitz estimate in periodic homogenization of high-contrast elliptic systems
arxiv-2404-11396.creator: Xin Fu, Wenjia Jing
arxiv-2404-11396.description: Abstract . We consider the Dirichlet problem for elliptic systems with periodically distributed inclusions whose conduction parameter exhibits a significant contrast compared to the background media. We develop a unified method to quantify the convergence rates both as the periodicity of inclusions tends to zero and as the parameter approaches either zero or infinity.

arxiv-2405-15704.title: Quantum nondemolition measurement operator with spontaneous emission
arxiv-2405-15704.creator: Ebubechukwu O. Ilo-Okeke, Tim Byrnes
arxiv-2405-15704.description: Abstract We present a theory for quantum nondemolition (QND) measurements of an atomic ensemble in the presence of spontaneous emission. We derive the master equation that governs the evolution of the ground state of the atoms and the quantum state of light.

arxiv-2410-17340.title: Distribution of rational points of an algebraic surface over finite fields
arxiv-2410-17340.creator: Sudhir Pujahari, Neelam Saikia
arxiv-2410-17340.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sudhir Pujahari, Neelam Saikia. The number of points on a certain one parameter family of algebraic surface over a finite field 𝔽 p \mathbb{F}_{p} can be expressed as p 2 + A p ​ ( λ ) , p^{2}+A_{p}(\lambda), where A p ​ ( λ ) A_{p}(\lambda) is a character sum and λ \lambda is an element of the finite field 𝔽 p .

arxiv-2411-01328.title: Probing trade-off between critical size and velocity in cold-spray: An atomistic simulation
arxiv-2411-01328.creator: Mahyar Ghasemi, Alireza Seifi, Movaffaq Kateb, Jon Tomas Gudmundsson, Pascal Brault, Pirooz Marashi
arxiv-2411-01328.description: Abstract The detailed mechanism of bonding in the cold spray process has remained elusive for both experimental and theoretical parties. Adiabatic shear instability and hydrodynamic plasticity models have been so far the most popular explanations. Here, using molecular dynamics simulation, we investigate their validity at the nanoscale.

arxiv-2503-15783.title: Grammar and Gameplay-aligned RL for Game Description Generation with LLMs
arxiv-2503-15783.creator: Tsunehiko Tanaka, Edgar Simo-Serra
arxiv-2503-15783.description: Abstract Game Description Generation (GDG) is the task of generating a game description written in a Game Description Language (GDL) from natural language text. Previous studies have explored generation methods leveraging the contextual understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs); however, accurately reproducing the game features of the game descriptions remains a challenge.

arxiv-2503-16070.title: Search for radiative leptonic decay D + → γ ​ e + ​ ν e D^{+}\to\gamma e^{+}\nu_{e} using deep learning
arxiv-2503-16070.description: Abstract Using 20.3 fb − 1 \mathrm{fb}^{-1} of e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation data collected at a center-of-mass energy of 3.773 GeV \,\mathrm{GeV} with the BESIII detector, we report on an improved search for the radiative leptonic decay D + → γ ​ e + ​ ν e D^{+}\to\gamma e^{+}\nu_{e} .

arxiv-2504-05198.title: Bayesian estimation of causal effects from observational categorical data
arxiv-2504-05198.creator: Vera Kvisgaaard, Johan Pensar
arxiv-2504-05198.description: Abstract We present a Bayesian procedure for estimation of pairwise intervention effects in a high-dimensional system of categorical variables. We assume that we have observational data generated from an unknown causal Bayesian network for which there are no latent confounders.

arxiv-2505-23946.title: Lessons Learned: A Multi-Agent Framework for Code LLMs to Learn and Improve
arxiv-2505-23946.creator: Yuanzhe Liu, Ryan Deng, Tim Kaler, Xuhao Chen, Charles E. Leiserson, Yao Ma, Jie Chen
arxiv-2505-23946.description: Abstract Recent studies show that LLMs possess different skills and specialize in different tasks. In fact, we observe that their varied performance occur in several levels of granularity. For example, in the code optimization task, code LLMs excel at different optimization categories and no one dominates others.

pmc-10522865.creator: Daryush Varedi, Vivek Bhatt, Mariam Asadian, Soheil Sharifi-Amina, Shiv Bhanu, Duy Bui, Tae Hun Kim, Justin Wei
pmc-10522865.description: Cystadenofibromas (CAF) and adenofibromas (AF) are rare benign gynecologic neoplasms of epithelial origin. They can be composed predominantly of solid fibrous tissue, adenofibromas, or contain cystic components, as seen in cystadenofibromas; which can be further classified by their epithelial cell type (serous, mucinous, etc.).

pmc-10641166.title: BATF2 inhibits PD-L1 expression and regulates CD8+ T-cell infiltration in non–small cell lung cancer
pmc-10641166.creator: Junwei Liu, Jie Li, Zhan Tuo, Weidong Hu, Jun Liu
pmc-10641166.description: Immune checkpoint blockades have made huge breakthrough among some cancer types including lung cancer. However, only a small proportion of patients will benefit from immune checkpoint blockades; other patients have no or minor response to immunotherapy. The underlying mechanisms and efficient biomarkers to predict immunotherapy resistances remain unclear and lacking.

pmc-13210996.title: A Radar-Based Contactless System for Joint Phonocardiogram Reconstruction and Cardiac State Segmentation Using a Self-Attention 1D U-Net
pmc-13210996.creator: Giulio Montanari, Marco Mura, Pasquale Di Viesti, Elia Vignoli, Giorgio Guerzoni, Giorgio Matteo Vitetta
pmc-13210996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Contactless vital signs monitoring is becoming increasingly relevant in scenarios where conventional sensors are impractical or not recommended. In this manuscript, a radar-based contactless system for the joint reconstruction of phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms and cardiac state segmentation is illustrated. The proposed method exploits a self-attention one-dimensional (1D) U-Net fed by a pre-processed radar-derived input to estimate a PCG-like waveform, its envelope, and the four main cardiac phases: S1, systole, S2, and diastole.

pmc-13376757.title: Chiral packings in cylinders are ultrasensitive to confinement deformation
pmc-13376757.creator: Xuebin Wang, Jiahao Guo, Yao Li
pmc-13376757.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Sphere packings in circular cylinders have attracted substantial research interest, among which the discovery of chiral helical structures is the most iconic. However, recent experimental results on zebrafish do not match the known packing structures in circular cylinders. To account for the inherent imperfections of biological tubes, we take elliptic cylinders as the canonical deformation of circular cylinders and investigate the densest packings of hard spheres in them using simulation, theory, and experiments.

pmc-13439498.title: Bioinspired peptide cyclisation enables exploration of cytochrome P450 catalysed sequential oxidation in rufomycin biosynthesis
pmc-13439498.creator: Jessica Peate, Yaoyu Ding, Joshua Tomkins, Harry R. Winter, Jingwen Zhang, Cameron M. L. Coleman, Priya Solanki, Jake H. Nicholson, Toby Hopkinson, Gustavo Perez-Ortiz, Alex P. S. Brogan, Timothy D. McHugh, Robert E. Jefferson, Sarah M. Barry
pmc-13439498.description: Natural product biosynthetic cytochrome P450s (CYPs) are of increasing interest for their incredible ability to selectively activate inert C–H bonds on highly complex substrates. However, these enzymes are understudied due to difficulties accessing substrates. Here, we use our recently developed peptide cyclisation chemistry to produce a library of natural product peptide analogues to study the rufomycin tailoring CYP, RufM.

pmc-13540538.title: Percutaneous Closure of Patent Foramen Ovale in a Patient With Incomplete Cor Triatriatum Sinister: A Case Report
pmc-13540538.creator: Anastasios Apostolos, Maria Drakopoulou, Elias Tolis, Georgios Trantalis, Ioannis Kachrimanidis, Panayotis Vlachakis, Konstantinos Tsioufis, Konstantinos Toutouzas, Konstantina Aggeli
pmc-13540538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We present the case of a 55‐year‐old male with no significant medical history who experienced a cryptogenic ischemic stroke, likely due to a patent foramen ovale (PFO) in the setting of an incomplete cor triatriatum sinister (CTS). Transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) revealed a complex interatrial septum with a long tunnel PFO and an incomplete crescent‐like membrane in the left atrium, consistent with CTS. Despite the anatomical challenges, a 30 mm GORE Cardioform Septal Occluder was successfully implanted.
